positions.title: Freelance Web Developer/Web Designer
positions.description:
Define strategy for and develop, execute, and manage comprehensive internet marketing plans for local businesses designed to penetrate and grow targeted markets. Communicate with management, internal departments, and vendors to coordinate overall marketing effort in accordance with corporate goals. Play integral role in brand development activities. 
Selected Contributions:
Development of web applications and web pages.
Development of marketing collateral.
Internet-based research of marketing strategies and ideas.
Provide effective and prompt customer service to clients

Administered campus WordPress multi-site installation to meet blogging needs of campus community.
